title: the driving HUD fits with a destination set
lensAText: a sceptical game UI designer and QA lead. Look at every before/after frame with the Read tool, then take your own in ONE short Playwright script on dist/artifact.html: choose Stoppage Time in Go To, drive with and without Auto-drive, in the OC Hypercar and the Rossini GT, at 1450x767, 1350x750, 1280x600 and 844x390 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3), try every HUD style and a resize mid-drive. Judge: is every item the owner listed fixed, does nothing overlap or clip, is the navigation easy to read at a glance, is the right rail clear and usable, does everything still work (Go to, Auto-drive, Pause, Thrust, Focus Time, the corner window)?
brief: THE OWNER (2026-11-09 ~12:15 PM PT), with two screenshots of the live game (v14) in a laptop browser window, driving the OC Hypercar with Stoppage Time chosen in Go To: "lets fix the interface when i choose a destiantion". (The screenshots were lost in the machine reset; this is what they showed.) At 1450x767: (1) the DESTINATION card (Stoppage Time, 7.2 mi, 2 min, No traffic, with 'at your pace' and 'simulated') sits under the right-hand button rail (VIEW, GO TO, AUTO-DRIVE, RADIO, PAUSE): VIEW covers its right half so 'at your pace' and 'simulated' are hidden; (2) the top-left directions card ('4.6 mi KEEP RIGHT', the I-5 NORTH shield, 'EXIT Euclid Street') is clipped at the top and on the left ('EXIT' shows as 'IT'); (3) the route shield at the top centre ('22 EAST') is clipped at the top; (4) the THRUST and FOCUS TIME buttons and the drive-chip row under the speed (CUSTOM, ABS, TCS, UNLEASHED) are cut off by the bottom edge; (5) the right side is crowded. At 1350x750 the right side runs off the screen: the rail shows only the left half of each button, the sky-camera window is cut at the right edge, the DESTINATION card is cut and still overlaps the rail, the THRUST panel is cut, and the speed box is cut at the right and the bottom: the HUD overflows the viewport's width as well as its height (check 100vw with a scrollbar, fixed widths, the artifact viewer's frame, transforms, min-widths). FIX at the source so destination mode is clean at every size: with a destination set (Auto-drive on and off), nothing overlaps and nothing is clipped by the viewport or its safe areas, at 1450x767, 1350x750, 1366x768, 1280x720, 1440x900, 1920x1080, 1280x600, phone 390x844 and 844x390 (DPR 3, isMobile, hasTouch, viewport-meta copy), for the OC Hypercar (THRUST and FOCUS TIME shown) and the Rossini GT, every HUD style. Target: the next manoeuvre and the destination read as ONE navigation panel at the top left (next turn, shield, exit, then destination name, distance, time and traffic, with 'at your pace' and 'simulated' visible), sized to fit; the right rail stays clear and becomes compact (smaller or icon-first) on short windows; bottom controls and chips always fully inside the viewport. Keep the corner window, the Thrust panel, the speed box and the road chevrons working; respect reduced motion; keep the style guide's tokens and every control. ADD a regression check (phone group or the nav-card group) that sets a destination and asserts from the DOM at 1450x767, 1350x750, 1280x600, 390x844 and 844x390 that no two visible HUD boxes overlap and every visible HUD box is inside the viewport (minus safe areas), for the hypercar. PROVE: npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build (owner-test mark kept); npm test -- --only=boot,phone,venues; BEFORE (c3962c5, from a scratch copy outside the worktree) and AFTER frames at 1450x767, 1350x750, 1280x600, 1920x1080, 390x844 and 844x390 with Stoppage Time chosen, into tests/out/nav-hud/.
